![](../assets/logo.png){width="30%" fig-align="center"}


The Children's Environmental Health Initiative (CEHI) is a research, education, and outreach program
committed to fostering environments where all people can prosper. We also believe that the spatial
data has the power to enable better public health decision making. So, as part of our commitment to
education, we provide GIS trainings to local, state, and tribal public health professionals. These
trainings are part of an ongoing effort to build GIS capacity within public health departments across the US.

### Get in contact with us

Would you like to hear about our upcoming training opportunities? Join the Chronic Disease GIS
Network (CDGISN)! The Chronic Disease GIS Network is a place to connect with other public health
professional using GIS within their work and hear about upcoming trainings. 

::: {style="display: flex; justify-content: center;"}
[Join CDGISN](https://forms.gle/wjthQRdvg4qysxTS9){.btn .btn-primary}
:::
